decisions.proposed_text: Tăng giới hạn Speed và Power,\nSpark giúp giảm chi phí học Skill 「CUTTING×DRIVE!」
decisions.reason: The current phrase giảm giá Skill is an unnatural literal rendering of 技能折扣; revise to the established gameplay meaning of reduced Skill learning cost while preserving canonical terms.
decisions.terminology_basis: 速度 → Speed; 力量 → Power; 因子 → Spark in category 172; 技能 → Skill; locked Skill name CUTTING×DRIVE! is preserved.
